title: Auto-Targeting SDD progress tracker
description: Living record of completed stages in the SDD workflow (see SDD-SPEC.md §12). Append-only — never edit a completed entry; add a new one to supersede. The anti-loop policy (§12) requires that if the gap between the current state and the expected state does not shrink for 3 consecutive steps on a branch, the agent MUST stop and switch to an alternative approach or escalate.

hardware_tests.name: Live camera demo end-to-end (camera → NPU → detections → annotated MP4)
hardware_tests.device: Orange Pi 5 + Arducam OV9782 USB + RK3588 NPU

results.pipeline: V4L2 MJPG → jpeg-decoder → letterbox 640×640 → rknn-bridge Unix-socket → NPU zero-copy rknn_set_io_mem → YOLOv8 sigmoid+NMS → cv-visualizer boxes+labels → ffmpeg MP4

limitations: Only 5 frames captured — v4l crate early-terminates capture loop (known issue, fix: switch to V4l2DirectSource feature v4l2-direct)

convert.rs: yuyv_to_rgb24/nv12 OOB on last pixel pair -> panic on first frame [ec10230]
live_camera_demo: pump loop broke on channel Full (not just Closed) -> capture died at frame 5; also explains Arducam '5 frames' mystery [a15e427]

hardware_tests.name: TG26-160: shmem ring buffer — acceptance + hardware

results.tests: 24/24 on x86 (15 unit + 7 acceptance + 2 doctest); clippy -D warnings clean
results.memory_budget: default 10 x 640x480 NV12 = 4.4 MB (0.12% RAM); verified by test
results.multiprocess_linux: PASS on RK3588: 25/25 tests incl. 2 multiprocess (torn-free) + crash-reaper; criterion: publish 460KB=18.0us (23.8 GiB/s), acquire+release=162ns, roundtrip=26.2us; live demo producer 30fps + next/slow consumers, TORN=0, clean unlink
results.pivot: memfd+linkat disproven on target kernel (ENOENT/EXDEV, ctypes-probed) -> POSIX shm open(O_CREAT|O_EXCL), commit 982c88b
incidents_fixed_during_dev: publish() missing ref_count.store(0, Release) — slots stuck in WRITER_LOCK (hang)
arena alloc not zeroed — garbage ref_counts on heap reuse (order-dependent cascade)
test design: magic frame count vs drop-new; walk window; acceptance held wrong slot

hardware_tests.name: TG26-125: video-recorder — first real SHM consumer

results.tests: 2 unit + doctest cross-platform; ffmpeg smoke (ffprobe h264) + multiprocess integration green on RK3588 (--include-ignored)
results.live_run: producer 640x480 NV12@30fps (446 published, 0 dropped) + recorder OSD 12s (RECORDED=353, OSD=353, JUMPS=1) + PARALLEL consumer (VERIFIED=237, TORN=0) — non-blocking proven
results.design: guard discipline: frame copied and FrameGuard dropped BEFORE conversion/OSD/pipe-write — blocked ffmpeg pipe can never freeze a ring slot
